chapter: Faking parts and the Tuxedo bands
title: How High Society was made from a piccolo part
summary: Ridgley says High Society came from a piccolo band part rearranged for clarinet. He credits Picou, George Baquet and a Tio, and names Lorenzo Tio as a clarinetist.
